cases.question: 各区域销售额
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

cases.question: 各区域分别有多少笔销售记录
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS sale_count FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

cases.question: 销售金额最高的一笔记录是什么
cases.gold_sql: SELECT id, region, amount FROM sales ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 已支付订单各商品类别的销售额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: 哪些客户没有已支付订单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) = 0 ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: 2026年8月已支付订单数和收款金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01'

cases.question: 每个客户累计已收款金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: 按区域统计已支付订单的收款金额
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

cases.question: 各区域已支付订单数和订单商品行数分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_order_count, COUNT(oi.id) AS item_line_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

cases.question: 订单按状态分别有多少笔
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

cases.question: 逐笔列出已支付订单的商品金额和实收金额
cases.gold_sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS item_amount FROM order_items AS oi GROUP BY oi.order_id), payment_totals AS (SELECT pay.order_id, SUM(pay.amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments AS pay GROUP BY pay.order_id) SELECT o.id, it.item_amount, pt.paid_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN item_totals AS it ON it.order_id = o.id JOIN payment_totals AS pt ON pt.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' ORDER BY o.id
